items.name: Evidence Gatekeeper
items.description: Checks evidence references, distinguishes supported inputs from unsupported claims, and preserves NOT_YET_VERIFIED status.

items.name: Task Decomposer & Scope Binder
items.description: Binds a requested task to explicit scope, required inputs, acceptance criteria, and prohibited out-of-scope actions.

items.name: Deterministic Action Filter
items.description: Evaluates proposed actions against explicit allow/deny rules and returns a traceable decision record.

items.name: Logic Trader — Paper Risk Gate
items.description: Synthetic-price demo of trend-rule decisions, position caps, abrupt-move halts, and simulated fills; not connected to a broker or exchange.

commercial_boundary: No live checkout, payment processing, wallet, token minting, or real-money trading is configured. Price, license, chain, token contract, and publication target require owner configuration.
